issue_context.title: Can't use `vars` in playbook when using collections
issue_context.body:
<!--- Verify first that your issue is not already reported on GitHub -->
<!--- Also test if the latest release and devel branch are affected too -->
<!--- Complete *all* sections as described, this form is processed automatically -->

##### SUMMARY
<!--- Explain the problem briefly below -->
When using collection with HTTP API plugin, it's not possible to use any kind of `vars` from the playbook
##### ISSUE TYPE
- Bug Report

##### COMPONENT NAME
<!--- Write the short name of the module, plugin, task or feature below, use your best guess if unsure -->
ansible collection

##### ANSIBLE VERSION
<!--- Paste verbatim output from "ansible --version" between quotes -->
```paste below
2.9
```

##### CONFIGURATION
<!--- Paste verbatim output from "ansible-config dump --only-changed" between quotes -->
```paste below

```

##### OS / ENVIRONMENT
<!--- Provide all relevant information below, e.g. target OS versions, network device firmware, etc. -->


##### STEPS TO REPRODUCE
<!--- Describe exactly how to reproduce the problem, using a minimal test-case -->
Following play fails when trying to fetch `vars` value through `get_option('domain')` (ref: https://github.com/ansible/ansible/pull/63976/files#diff-911386a804691dadae5f292b64df16a9R47) when used via `ansible collections` but works as expected and gets the `vars` value when used directly from `core` side.
<!--- Paste example playbooks or commands between quotes below -->
```yaml
- hosts: checkpoint
  connection: httpapi
  tasks:
    - name: create new mgmt
      cp_mgmt_host:
        name: "Sales Web Server 2"
        ip_address: 10.0.10.121
      register: show_network_response
      vars:
        ansible_checkpoint_domain: "System Data"
```

<!--- HINT: You can paste gist.github.com links for larger files -->

##### EXPECTED RESULTS
<!--- Describe what you expected to happen when running the steps above -->
Get the `vars` value from ansible collections

##### ACTUAL RESULTS
<!--- Describe what actually happened. If possible run with extra verbosity (-vvvv) -->
Fail to retrieve the `vars` value from ansible collections side
<!--- Paste verbatim command output between quotes -->
```paste below

```
